## History

Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as the community's new minister alongside his wife, with the young couple still on their honeymoon at the start of his ministry. During an early visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, he and his wife admired [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's decorated table, and Allan engaged in a pleasant conversation with [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Though his wife maintained a warm, supportive presence in the community—comforting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after a baking mishap, hosting her at the manse, and later conversing with her about teaching and life goals—Allan remained settled in his role leading the local parish.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is a supportive and approving acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who admires the young girl's enthusiasm and warmth. The two first bonded after Mrs. Allan graciously comforted a devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who had accidentally flavored a layer cake with liniment during a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Mrs. Allan later invited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tea at the manse, further cementing a friendly rapport where she listens to Anne's thoughts and shares local community news.

- Friend of — supportive acquaintance who approves of Anne's choices  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029), +2 more</sub>
